# Yomu AI

> > Yomu AI is an AI-powered writing assistant that helps students write essays and papers 10x faster with advanced tools for outlining, paraphrasing, and thesis generation.

Yomu AI provides a comprehensive suite of AI writing tools designed specifically for academic writing and essay composition. The platform integrates multiple advanced language models including Claude, GPT, and Gemini variants to deliver high-quality writing assistance while maintaining academic integrity standards.

## Core Writing Tools

- [Yomu AI - Write Essays & Papers 10x Faster](https://www.yomu.ai): Yomu AI homepage: AI writing tool for students to write essays and papers faster
- [AI Essay Outline Generator](https://www.yomu.ai/essay-outline-generator): Essay outline generator tool for structuring essays and overcoming writer's block
- [AI Thesis Statement Generator](https://www.yomu.ai/thesis-statement-generator): Thesis statement generator for creating clear, compelling academic thesis statements
- [AI Paraphrasing Tool](https://www.yomu.ai/paraphrasing-tool): Paraphrasing tool for rewriting text while maintaining original meaning
- [AI Sentence Rewriter](https://www.yomu.ai/sentence-rewriter): Sentence rewriter tool for improving and polishing sentences
- [AI Sentence Expander](https://www.yomu.ai/sentence-expander): Sentence expander tool to transform short sentences into detailed content
